user.title: Homeplanarr
user.description: Create a household API key in Homeplanarr under Household → API access (full access) and paste it here.

data_description.url: Your Homeplanarr address. Keep the default unless you run your own.

entities.title: What to send
entities.description: You can change this later under Configure.

data.forward_tags: Forward NFC tag scans to Homeplanarr chores

data_description.energy_entities: Meters that count kWh and only go up. Pick every meter in the house; the integration sums them itself, no helper or utility meter needed. Send electricity from one place only (not also via Tibber).
data_description.energy_interval: Each finished period is sent with its start time, so it is priced against the right hour.
data_description.water_entities: Total meters; the use per hour is sent in litres.
data_description.solar_entities: Total production meters; the production per hour is sent.
data_description.level_entities: The current value is sent once an hour. The entity's area is matched to a room with the same name.
data_description.battery_entities: Shown under Integrations with a low-battery warning.
data_description.forward_tags: Tags registered in Homeplanarr complete their chore. Other tags are ignored.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: Homeplanarr no longer accepts the key. Create a new one under Household → API access.

error.invalid_auth: The key was not accepted. Use a full-access household key that has not expired.
error.no_subscription: The household has no active subscription.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Homeplanarr at that address.

abort.already_configured: That Homeplanarr address is already set up.
